item.title: EU AI Act Article 5: AI Practices You're Banned From Using
item.description: The EU AI Act’s Article 5 prohibited AI practices have applied since 2 February 2025 — these are not a future deadline, they are live red lines every organisation is already bound by. Most small teams have never read Article 5 in full, and assume “prohibited practices” means something distant: mass surveillance, social credit systems, government overreach. Four of the eight bans sit much closer to home, in ordinary HR, marketing, and analytics tooling.
